priorityList: Use Pummel to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Use Recklessness and Avatar on cooldown, ideally together.
Cast Thunder Blast if you have 2 stacks of the Thunder Blast buff.
Cast Thunder Blast while Avatar is active.
Cast Thunder Clap (or Thunder Blast) if your Whirlwind cleave buff is missing to ensure your attacks hit all targets.
Cast Rampage if you are at 100+ Rage or if Enrage is about to expire.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active to avoid overcapping Rage.
Cast Bloodthirst to generate Rage and maintain Enrage.
Cast Execute if the target is in execute range or if Sudden Death procs.
Cast Thunder Clap as your primary filler for AoE damage and Rage generation.
Cast Crushing Blow or Raging Blow as secondary fillers.
Use offensive trinkets and racial combat buffs (like Berserking) during Recklessness.
